# Benchmark: cold runs, a fresh session in an empty folder for every attempt
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #91, sha256:5fee7e3ddbf72b543333744532c55156f3a7a0dab6d52b4932146a11d38c6345). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Done 2026-10-27 (b2bc7bd and 3155266: --cold with a neutral preamble, per-CLI extras verified against the real CLIs, fresh empty workdir per attempt; gate 238 + 58; Decider D42 passed)
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** feature (thin slice; a benchmark change needs its own Decider and old rows stay labeled)
- **Milestone:** Measure first: does Phrase beat plain C# on tokens and attempts?
- **Source:** Thin-slice rule (Decider D18) applied to old card 037 (it bundled six criteria and a harness defect), under the agile ruling (VISION ruling 6), while the product owner's measure-first priority (Decider D31) needs the docs-in-context mode for the Phrase arm of the head-to-head. Sliced by the facilitator and PM 2026-10-27; any seat may challenge it.
- **Depends on:** 090
- **Story:** As Riley, I want each model run to start in a fresh session with no memory or project context, in an empty working directory, using that CLI's own flags, so that I can trust that a pass came from the language and the documentation, not from a warm session or from the model searching the repo.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given each model CLI, When a run starts, Then it uses a fresh session in an empty working directory with that CLI's own cold flags, and the flags are recorded in the row; a run that cannot be made cold is labeled warm and is not counted in a baseline
  2. Given a prompt that exceeds a model's context or turn limit, When it runs, Then the row is recorded unavailable with that reason and is not scored as a language failure
  3. Given a recorded reply that begins with a tool log (a model that searched the filesystem), When the cold flags are in force, Then the fixture shows the model had no repository to search (the check fails if the working directory is not empty)
